name: w4
description: W4 cells: the chunk merge at block N 8192 (M 4 runs of 2048 at k 2048, M 8 runs of 1024 at k 1024, plus N 4096 k 512 for M 8) and the warp sorted-output crossover (N 1024 and 2048 at k 64 and 1024, N 512 k 256 boundary). bf16 and fp32, both requirements, random input, both regimes.
